rerun.detail: The run's scripts are not in this tree, nor the copies of the seawater and gsw Python packages it used. Its inputs are public Argo files from data-argo.ifremer.fr and mixedlayer.ucsd.edu, named in PREREG.md; their sha256s were recorded in a manifest in the run's folder, which does not ship.

It is blind to the values only: the method was known. The list and the prereg were written by the authors
